objective: Design the FEATURES contents page of DIS Magazine's Data Issue in the layout bones of the reference 1990s music-magazine contents page: saturated color-field background, oversized page numbers, stacked feature list, one dominant photograph.
reference_role: Reference image 1 is the layout authority: color-field treatment, header type scale, list rhythm, photo placement. None of its words or images may appear. Reference image 2 supplies the sole photograph: a colorful abstract browser-window artwork used as the contents-page art.
preservation_invariants: Keep the donor's structure: big section word at top, issue identifier line under it, vertical list of feature entries each with an oversized page number, one large photograph anchoring the layout.
Keep the period print finish and the donor's confident use of one saturated background color.
canvas: Portrait magazine page, 3:4 aspect, full bleed color field.
The reference 2 artwork sits as the single large tilted photograph, styled as a printed photo with a thin white border and drop shadow, occupying the same zone the donor photo occupies.

regions.name: section header
regions.change: Top reads 'CONTENTS' in the donor's huge condensed caps, with the line 'THE DATA ISSUE · TOO BIG TO SCALE' beneath it in small caps.

regions.name: feature list
regions.change: Exactly six entries, each an article title in bold caps with the author name in lighter small caps beneath and an oversized two-digit page number beside it: 'LANDING SITES / TREVOR PAGLEN / 08', 'CULTS AT SCALE / KATE LOSSE / 14', 'WHAT CAN AN ALGORITHM DO? / JOSH SCANNELL / 20', 'METAPHORS OF BIG DATA / SARA M. WATSON / 26', 'BITS AND ATOMS / HOLLY HERNDON & HANNES GRASSEGGER / 32', 'MACHINE VISION / BENJAMIN BRATTON / 38'.
preserve: The donor's list rhythm, rules between entries, and number scale.

style: Mid-1990s American music-magazine interior: heavy condensed and outlined display type, aggressive section headers, layered photo collage energy, warm coated-paper white, CMYK halftone grain.
Typography classification only: condensed grotesque display, outlined slab accents, small dense sans body columns; no digital-era fonts.
asset_rules: Use the photograph from reference image 2 exactly once as the page's primary art; crop is allowed, distortion and mirroring are not.
Ignore the flat gray matte surrounding the photograph in reference image 2; it is packing material, not content.
negative_constraints: No legible paragraph-length body text anywhere: running text must be greeked, soft-blurred print texture that is clearly type but unreadable at full size.
Do not reproduce the donor page's own photographs, advertisements, products, celebrities, phone numbers, or brand marks; the donor supplies layout bones and typographic idiom only.
No New York Magazine masthead, no VIBE masthead, no Newport/Absolut/Levi's or any real advertisement, no barcode with real digits, no real cover price.
No watermark, no border artifacts from the reference matte, no gray letterbox bars carried into the composition.
No misspelled masthead, no duplicated headline, no extra unrelated cover lines, no modern flat-UI aesthetic, no smartphone-era design elements.
No table-of-contents entries other than the six specified.
quality_checks: At thumbnail size the page reads as an authentic mid-1990s printed magazine page: coated-paper tone, slight halftone grain, period type rendering.
Every exact-copy string is legible, spelled exactly as specified, and appears exactly once.
The transplanted DIS photograph is clearly recognizable and undistorted, integrated with period-correct print reproduction.
